feed.title: Truebex changelog
feed.subtitle: Releases and milestones of the Truebex building design platform.

entry.title: Truebex 1.0.0
entry.content: The first release build: a 445 MB install that starts in 4.6 s, with drawing sheets, finishes, references, dynamic objects and the asset library on board.

entry.title: One library for every asset
entry.content: Textures, meshes, objects, sections, faces and sheet templates live in one library with categories, tags, search and favourites. Save embedded, linked or both; missing links heal on relink.

entry.title: Mouldings at door jambs and along curved walls
entry.content: Skirtings and mouldings stop flush at door jambs, follow the door, and run along curved walls; ceiling panels and slabs meet cleanly at the soffit.

entry.title: Doors, windows, cabinets and stairs from numbers
entry.content: Dynamic doors, windows, cabinets and custom objects regenerate with their host wall, stairs build from a run, and category prototypes stand in until you swap in the real thing.

entry.title: One look for every screen
entry.content: Every panel, menu and dialog shares one kit and a live theme: accent colour, corner radius, density, light and dark.

entry.title: Walls from any curve
entry.content: Draw walls from lines, arcs, splines and other curves, with smooth curved surfaces, and resize anything with the Scale command.

entry.title: Models with a feature list
entry.content: Build models step by step with a feature list and an edit mode, sweeps that face the viewer, and control points that place handles and fixtures.

entry.title: Dimensions that keep up
entry.content: Dimension styles for plan, 3D and sheets, auto dimensions that stay current as the model moves, relevance per view, and pins that keep chosen dimensions visible.

entry.title: Panels and finishes on any face
entry.content: Paint, wallpaper and three-dimensional patterns, and panels on floors, ceilings, slabs and models as well as walls.

entry.title: Drawing sheets that lay themselves out
entry.content: One command creates the sheet set: cover, plans, sections, stair sheets, face sketches, renders and schedules, with forms you fill once. Truebex writes its own vector PDF, with selectable text and fillable fields, and DXF.

entry.title: Textures and meshes from your own files
entry.content: Import textures with full compression and mip levels, and meshes in glTF, GLB, OBJ and FBX, then compose your own objects from them.

entry.title: Anything references anything
entry.content: Lines, objects and faces can reference each other and follow what they reference when it moves.
